heading: Indexing Layer Standard
text: Use layered indexing: stable door, live router, curated section indexes, generated machine index, semantic-ready chunk corpus, optional embeddings runtime, and optional graph-memory layer. Generated indexes are navigation aids and do not replace canonical source files.

heading: Semantic Index Architecture
text: Semantic search is an optional retrieval layer. It should use filtered chunks to locate likely context, then verify lifecycle status, freshness, scope, and the canonical repository file before relying on the result.
